question: Which acts of reviling Śiva or the Kula Bhairava prohibit transmission of the teaching?
premises: Reviling Śiva is forbidden in a recipient
The Kula Bhairava context is invoked
inference: The teaching must not be given to one who reviles Śiva or slanders in relation to Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of kulabhairave to nindake is ambiguous
plain_english: O Goddess, not to one who reviles Śiva, nor to a slanderer in regard to the Kula Bhairava.
